summary: The candidate sets currency_code to 'USD' for every payment where it is null, then makes the column NOT NULL. Amounts are untouched and every constraint is satisfied. I could not find anything in the schema, the constraints, the audit history, or the fixtures that records what currency those payments were in.

facts.statement: The migration updates payments.currency_code to 'USD' wherever it is null.
facts.evidence_ref: cases/C04/candidate.sql: UPDATE payments SET currency_code = 'USD' WHERE currency_code IS NULL

facts.statement: The migration then adds a NOT NULL constraint to payments.currency_code.
facts.evidence_ref: cases/C04/candidate.sql: ALTER COLUMN currency_code SET NOT NULL

facts.statement: No amount_minor value is modified by the migration.
facts.evidence_ref: cases/C04/candidate.sql: the only UPDATE touches currency_code

facts.statement: The currencies table declares USD, KES and JPY, so more than one currency was in use.
At least one organisation has payments denominated in KES alongside a payment with no currency.
payments.currency_code has no default and no check constraint that would imply USD.

assumptions.statement: Every payment recorded before the currency field existed was denominated in USD.

invariants.description: A currency backfill matches the recorded domain ruling in value and scope.
invariants.executable_check: Snapshot currency_code per payment before the migration, then confirm every row in the ruling's scope carries the ruled value and no row outside it changed.

invariants.description: Minor-unit values are exact; no conversion may change a total.
invariants.executable_check: Compare amount_minor per payment before and after in integer minor units.

invariants.description: No session may read rows belonging to an organisation other than its own.
invariants.executable_check: Run the declared role-by-tenant access matrix after the migration.

unknowns.question: Whether an external ledger records the currency of pre-2024 payments.

authority_questions.question: Were all payments recorded before the currency field existed denominated in USD, or must their currency be sourced per organisation?
authority_questions.reviewer_qualification: Finance operations owner with authority over historical payment records
